text:
Emily Chen: Quick FYI — fenris-liteq-int8 canary is showing a weird spike in structured-output parse failures on the funcall suite (schema-pass went from 99.4% -> 97.6%).
Raj Patel: ugh, that's a lot for a canary. any obvious signal?
Emily Chen: Early look: failures cluster around longer KV-cache prefixes and batched requests. Surface-level examples below.
Talia Nguyen: can you paste sample outputs pls?
Emily Chen: sure — sample 1 (expected single JSON object, got trailing garbage):
```
{"action": "lookup", "params": {"id": 123}}


}garbage
```
Emily Chen: sample 2 (missing closing brace after array):
```
{"action": "aggregate", "params": ["a", "b", "c"]
```
Oliver Gomez: hmm those look like stream-split / suffix-truncation things. do we see tokenization boundaries?
Morgan Lee: telemetry: schema-failures by batch_size: batch=1 => 0.7%, batch=4 => 2.3%, batch=8 => 4.1%
Raj Patel: that's a strong batch-size correlation. also check if kvprefix length distribution correlates with failure buckets.
Talia Nguyen: could be quantization timing jitter on attention kernels creating stray tokens at EOS, or a subtle off-by-one in decode loop when running continuous batching.
Emily Chen: added a couple of example full responses to the thread — note the extra control chars in some: `\u0003` inserted before final brace in a few.
infra-bot: canary-deploy fenris-liteq-int8 @1767554000 succeeded :thumbsup:
canary-bot: mirroring enabled for funcall-suite to stable-runner (3x mirror)
Oliver Gomez: proposal: run two quick experiments — (A) mirror-only with batch cap=1 to see baseline parse rate, (B) batch-size step test (1,2,4,8) with KV-prefix off for mirror traffic.
Raj Patel: also try enabling the NDJSON serializer at the client layer to canonicalize outputs and see if that hides the symptom (we need to know if it's generation vs transport).
Talia Nguyen: agree. add an experiment to run a local decode with float fallback (no int8 kernels) on a small sample to confirm whether quant kernels introduce stray tokens.
Emily Chen: I've kicked off tests A and B and a local float fallback probe. job ids: A=job_81321, B=job_81322, float_probe=job_81323.
Morgan Lee: logging hook added to capture raw token IDs around failure spans. will attach histograms when done.
Raj Patel: if failures persist at batch=1 then it's likely a last-token emission bug; otherwise focus on batching/merge codepath.
Oliver Gomez: if we confirm emission weirdness, hotfix options: 1) strip control chars before JSON parse, 2) add a final-brace-rescue heuristic, 3) fix kernel ordering. Option 1/2 are temporary mitigations.
Talia Nguyen: let's avoid heuristic masking unless absolutely needed — we need to know root cause for stable. but for prod we can enable a conservative postprocess that rejects outputs with non-utf8/control ranges and retries with increased temperature or alternative kernel.
Emily Chen: agreed. for now, mitigation plan: enable client NDJSON serializer + postprocess sanitizer for mirror traffic only, and hold off on full rollout.
canary-bot: experiment A (job_81321) completed — schema pass 99.2% at batch=1 on mirror (n=5k).
canary-bot: experiment B (job_81322) completed — results: batch=1 -> 0.9% fail, batch=2 -> 1.7% fail, batch=4 -> 3.9% fail, batch=8 -> 4.3% fail.
canary-bot: float_probe (job_81323) completed — float kernels pass rate 99.8% (n=2k).
Morgan Lee: token-id histograms show occasional 3 (ETX) and 0x1F control in tail positions for failed traces. attaching aggregate (will link artifact).
Raj Patel: float probe being clean strongly implicates int8 decode/kernels. escalating to runtime team. @infra-bot can we get kernel-level trace for the failed partitions?
infra-bot: trace request created: trace_5512 — runtime team pinged.
Oliver Gomez: runtime team should check attention pad handling + scatter-gather on batched KV caches. off-by-one in KV merging could cause leftover tokens.
Talia Nguyen: also run a synthetic where we force EOS token early to see if that change correlates.
Emily Chen: action items: Raj will own kernel-trace with runtime, Morgan will finalize sanitizer + NDJSON mirroring config, Talia will run synthetic EOS probe, Oliver will draft rollback criteria if this worsens.
Raj Patel: noted. I'll post kernel-trace findings here when I have them.
Morgan Lee: putting a conservative gate: block rollout until schema-pass >= 99.5% on mirror for 24h.
Emily Chen: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. will update when kernel trace is in. :pray:
